#!/bin/bash
exec > /var/log/userdata.log 2>&1
echo 'Starting Hospital Management System deployment...'
set -x

# Update system
yum update -y
yum install -y java-17-amazon-corretto-headless maven git

# Clone repository
cd /opt
sudo -u ec2-user git clone https://github.com/nithineleti/hospital-management-system.git
cd hospital-management-system

# Build the JAR
sudo -u ec2-user mvn clean package -DskipTests 2>&1 | tee /tmp/maven-build.log

# Create a systemd service
tee /etc/systemd/system/hospital-app.service > /dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Hospital Management System
After=network.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=ec2-user
WorkingDirectory=/opt/hospital-management-system
Environment="JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-amazon-corretto"
ExecStart=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-amazon-corretto/bin/java -Xmx512m -Xms256m -jar target/hospital-management-system-1.0.0.jar
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

# Fix permissions
chown -R ec2-user:ec2-user /opt/hospital-management-system

# Start the service
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable hospital-app.service
sudo systemctl start hospital-app.service

# Wait for app to start and verify
sleep 15
sudo systemctl status hospital-app.service
echo 'Hospital Management System started successfully!'
